author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹೀನಮನಸನು ಹೊಂದಿ ವಿಷಯಸುಖ ಬಯಸುವವ
ದಾನದಿಂದಲೆ ನಷ್ಟವಾಯಿತೆನ್ನುವವ
ತಾನೆ ತಿಳಿದವನೆಂದು ದರ್ಪದಿಂ ನಡೆವವನು
ಜ್ಞಾನಬಲಹೀನನವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: One who has a mean mind and craves sensual pleasure,
who says he lost out by giving to charity,
who walks with arrogance, thinking he alone knows —
he is weak in knowledge, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: A mean spirit, craving for pleasure, regret over giving, and arrogance about one’s own learning are all marks of someone lacking real wisdom.
